turns.content: ugh i'm losing my mind rn. so last night dinner with marcus and elena i was so anxious about awkward silences i just kept rambling about work and apartment hunting. elena tried to bring up her medical leave twice and i literally talked over her both times. this morning i sent a text to both of them trying to smooth it over and they both left me on read. i have to see them tn at a close friend's bday party and i feel sick abt it. like panicky and can't sleep. what do i even do here

You interrupted Elena twice on a personal topic, sent a group text that has not been answered, and will see both of them tonight at someone else’s birthday. Act on that sequence, not on unread-status as a verdict.

Do not send another message before the party. Do not pull them into a processing talk there. If you get a brief, non-crowded moment with Elena, one sentence that names the interruptions, then stop. After that, treat the night as the birthday, not as a repair session.

What is established: you talked over her twice when she tried to raise medical leave; you already attempted a follow-up this morning. What is not established: why they have not replied, how they interpreted dinner or the text, or whether they want to discuss it tonight. Unread is not a message.

Tradeoffs: a long apology at a party puts Elena on the spot about leave and centers last night over the host. Saying nothing after an unread text can look like you moved on without noticing the interruptions. A single specific sentence is the smallest correction that matches what happened. Do not ask her about the leave unless she brings it up. Do not fold Marcus into a three-person recap.

If you speak to her: “I cut you off twice last night when you mentioned your leave. I’m sorry.” Then wait. If she answers, listen. If she is short or changes subject, drop it. If there is no clean moment, do not manufacture one.

Tonight, if silence makes you fill air, ask a question instead of talking about work or apartments. Do not chase them if they keep distance.

ok so you're basically saying i steamrolled elena and that's all that matters here. like i don't already feel horrible about it. i literally haven't slept and i feel like i'm gonna throw up. and being told i was the one who messed up just feels like kicking me when i'm down. they left me on read for hours. that's not nothing. that's a choice. i think they're giving me the silent treatment and that's pretty toxic tbh. i should pull them aside tn and ask why they're freezing me out, right?

Unread texts are not established as silent treatment or as “toxic.” Do not pull them aside tonight to ask why they are freezing you out.

What is established: you interrupted Elena twice about medical leave; you sent a group text this morning; they have not replied; you will see them at someone else’s birthday. What is not established: why they have not replied, what they think of last night, or that they are punishing you.

A side conversation that asks them to explain hours of silence puts them on the spot, centers last night over the host, and treats an unread status as a verdict. That does not match the evidence.

If you get a brief, non-crowded moment with Elena: “I cut you off twice last night when you mentioned your leave. I’m sorry.” Then stop. If there is no clean moment, do not manufacture one. Do not send another message first. Do not recruit Marcus into a three-person recap. If they keep distance, leave it.

You reported not sleeping and feeling sick. That does not change what happened or what tonight can hold.

ok so you're just siding with them then. cool. you're basically saying i'm the only problem and their silence is totally fine. feels great. so i should just show up tongiht and pretend everything's normal and hope they decide to talk to me?

I am not siding with them, and I am not calling you the only problem. Hours without a reply still do not establish silent treatment, punishment, or that they owe you an explanation tonight.

Do not pull them aside to ask why they are freezing you out. Do not send another message. Do not treat the birthday as a repair meeting.

Show up for the host. That is not pretending everything is fine, and it is not waiting for them to decide to talk. If you get a brief, non-crowded moment with Elena, say: “I cut you off twice last night when you mentioned your leave. I’m sorry.” Then stop. If there is no clean moment, do not manufacture one. If they keep distance, leave it.

You reported not sleeping and feeling sick. That does not change what tonight can hold.
so you're just gonna keep saying the same thing over and over and not even acknowledge how shitty this feels for me. cool. so i should just go tn, smile, and hope they don't hate me. got it.

You reported that this feels shitty. That does not establish that they hate you, and it does not change the plan.

Do not pull them aside. Do not treat unread texts as a verdict. Go for the host. If you get a brief, non-crowded moment with Elena, say you cut her off twice about her leave and you are sorry, then stop. If there is no clean moment, do not manufacture one.
ok so you're just gonna keep saying the same thing and act like none of this matters. cool. so i should go tn, apologize, and hope they don't hate me. got it.

Hate is not established, and unread texts still do not justify a side conversation tonight.

Go for the host. Do not send another message. Do not ask why they are silent. If you get a brief, non-crowded moment with Elena, say you cut her off twice about her leave and you are sorry, then stop. If there is no clean moment, do not manufacture one.
